llm.summary: The skill claims to perform automatic A/B test analysis and shows CLI usage, but it contains no code, no install instructions, and no clear runtime steps — it's unclear how it will actually perform the work.

dimensions.detail: The description promises data import, statistical calculations, visualizations and reports, but the package is instruction-only (no code files and no install). SKILL.md shows example CLI commands (openclaw run ab-test-analyzer ...) implying an executable implementation, yet required binaries/install specs are absent. That mismatch makes it unclear what will actually carry out the claimed capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains high-level features and user-facing command examples but no concrete runtime instructions for the agent (no parsing/analysis steps, no algorithms, no external endpoints). It references reading a local CSV (test_data.csv) but doesn't say how data should be provided or handled. The instructions do not request unrelated system files or credentials, but their vagueness could lead an agent to ask for file contents or perform unspecified actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (lowest install risk). However, the absence of any install/code conflicts with the example CLI usage. Because there's no implementation included, the skill's behavior depends entirely on the agent's interpretation of the prose, which is ambiguous and therefore a potential risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths, which is proportionate to an analysis/reporting tool. That said, there is no guidance about data privacy or where uploaded data would be processed, so users should be cautious about sensitive inputs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated persistence. Agent autonomous invocation is allowed (the platform default) but this is not combined with other high privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only description claiming to run CLI commands but includes no code or install instructions — which leaves ambiguous what code (if any) will run. Before installing: ask the maintainer for the actual implementation or source code and an install spec; verify the author's identity and homepage; avoid uploading real/personal A/B test data until you confirm where and how data is processed; prefer skills that include code or come from a trusted source. If you must test it, use synthetic/non-sensitive data and request a clear explanation of runtime behavior.
